description: Main implementation file for Files API in a language model utility library, handling file operations such as create, retrieve, delete, list, and content fetch across multiple providers (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Anthropic). It includes both synchronous and asynchronous functions, manages provider-specific configurations, and integrates with various handler classes and utility functions.
